senses.gloss: c. (פרי, sec. r. of פרר; v. אַפִּרְיוֹן) [frame,] couch, esp. the bride’s litter.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 43:1">Pesik. R. s. 43</cite> <he>הושיבה עמרם בפ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A02817"><he>אַפִּרְיוֹן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:11:1">Cant. R. to IV, 11</cite> <he>מה כלה זו יושבת בפוּרְיָהּ וכ׳</he> as a bride is seated in her litter (is carried in procession, as if) saying, behold, I am pure &c.
